name: codex-luna-inline
description: Automatic inline code completions powered by GPT-5.6 Luna through your local, ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Source context is sent to the authenticated Codex CLI, so the extension runs only in trusted workspaces.

commands.title: Codex Luna Inline: Toggle Automatic Completions
Codex Luna Inline: Trigger Completion Now
Codex Luna Inline: Choose / Sign in to ChatGPT Account
Codex Luna Inline: Sign in with ChatGPT
Codex Luna Inline: Switch ChatGPT Account
Codex Luna Inline: Check Login Status
Codex Luna Inline: Show Output Log

codexLunaInline.codexPath.description: Codex CLI executable name or absolute path. This is an executable path only, not a shell command with arguments.

codexLunaInline.model.description: Codex model slug used for completions.

codexLunaInline.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort. Low is recommended for responsive inline completion.

codexLunaInline.debounceMs.description: Wait time after typing before requesting an automatic completion.

codexLunaInline.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time allowed for one Codex CLI completion.

codexLunaInline.maxPrefixChars.description: Maximum source characters sent before the cursor.

codexLunaInline.maxSuffixChars.description: Maximum source characters sent after the cursor.

codexLunaInline.maxWholeFileChars.description: Send the entire file when it is no larger than this limit. Larger files use a smart head/cursor/tail window.

codexLunaInline.usePersistentServer.description: Keep Codex app-server warm for lower completion latency. Disable only for compatibility troubleshooting.

codexLunaInline.maxSuggestionLines.description: Maximum number of lines in one inline suggestion.

codexLunaInline.excludedFiles.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns for files that must never be sent to Codex for completion.

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run test && vsce package --no-dependencies
